text: Luoyang lies in ruin, my lord! It is the work of the tyrant!
Dong Zhuo has brought shame upon the Han; his cruelty has plunged the realm into chaos!
He flees west with the young emperor; control of the Han goes with him.
Then His Majesty must be delivered from the tyrant’s grasp, and rightful order restored.
However, there are other, closer issues to deal with; Gongsun Zan grows ever more unruly…
His victories have made him proud. He must remember that strength exists to defend the people, not rule over them.
The coalition is dying; it lacks unity and leadership. Something must be done.
The Han does not need another ambitious warlord. It needs patience, unity, and men willing to place the realm above themselves.
The people of You Province look to you, lord Liu Yu; guide them through the gathering storm!
